task.title: P6-079: Strengthen the stepper zero-floor e2e coverage
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 9 — Dev loop, tests and test strength). Original id: P6-079. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**Strengthen the stepper zero-floor e2e** — it covers only the `−` click (`collection-view.spec.ts:1005-1046`) and typed-`0`-then-⏎ (`removal.spec.ts:173-174`); the keyboard (`ArrowDown`, `-`), paste, negative-number and non-numeric paths were verified live by review but have no coverage anywhere.
